articles.title: Optimizing Extraction Yield via Dynamic Pressure Profiling
articles.summary: Exploring how shifting from 9 bar to a declining pressure profile (6 bar) during the secondary phase reduces channeling and preserves delicate floral compounds in light-roasted Ethiopian beans.

articles.title: The Chemistry of Water: Magnesium vs. Calcium Extraction
articles.summary: An in-depth analysis of how water mineral content alters flavor profiles. Magnesium excels at extracting fruit-forward acids, while calcium emphasizes heavy chocolate and nutty notes.

articles.title: Decelerating the Rate of Rise (RoR) During the First Crack
articles.summary: How thermal momentum management during the end of the dry phase prevents baked flavors and ensures high sweetness in high-altitude washed coffees.

articles.title: Flat vs. Conical Grinder Burrs: Particle Size Distribution Analysis
articles.summary: A laser diffraction test comparing flat burrs (unimodal distribution) against conical burrs (bimodal distribution) and their resulting impact on espresso mouthfeel and clarity.

articles.title: Mastering the Pulsed Pour-Over Technique for V60
articles.summary: Using five distinct, timed pours to control agitation, contact time, and solubles yield, resulting in a cleaner, highly-delineated cup structure.

articles.title: Developing Anaerobic Natural Coffees: Fermentation & Roast Curves
articles.summary: Anaerobically fermented lots hold elevated sugars and organic acids. Discover the gentler charge temperatures and custom cooling cycles required to prevent scorching.
